name: Microbiology & Immunology PhD (College of Medicine)
summary: Microbiology and Immunology research training in pathogens, host responses and biomedical research.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall PhD application: domestic and international
publishedDeadlines.note: No year on official program deadline.

english.note: Biomedical sciences FAQ also accepts PTE61 or Cambridge185. U.S./U.K./Canada degree exemptions; documented fully English-taught BS/MS elsewhere may request waiver. No new TOEFL scale stated. Program page names TOEFL/IELTS; confirm other accepted tests.

requirements.note: Central bachelor’s-equivalent requirement. Catalog states no program minimums; competitive grades/research/letters expected. Rolling review; apply early. Foreign course-by-course NACES evaluation can follow review but is required after admission and for international math/science GPA form. One program application.

funding.note: Biomedical sciences FAQ says PhD candidates receive full-tuition fellowship, monthly stipend and health insurance; student fees, dental/vision additional. No explicit all-admitted or international guarantee stated.
